title: Best Alarm App Ever!🔥🔥
body:
Here’s a funnier, more convincing version:

As an iPhone user, I used to have trust issues with my alarms. 😭 I’d set 10 alarms, sleep peacefully… then wake up looking at the time like, “WHO CANCELLED MY RESPONSIBILITIES?!” 💀

Then I found this app on social media, downloaded it, and ever since… not a single missed alarm. 😂 It actually does its job!

The best part? It has a bunch of fun alarm sounds—from hilarious ones that’ll make you laugh to ones that practically drag your soul out of bed. 🤣

If you’re tired of playing Russian roulette with your morning alarms, do yourself a favor and get this app. My attendance record and my boss both approve. 😂❤️ I love it here! ♥️

title: Bought Alarmy Pro, can’t restore purchase. User feedback link goes to dead end.
body: I bought Alarmy Pro years ago. Every now and then I have to uninstall it and reinstall it. I had to do that 3 days ago, and I still cannot get the app to restore my purchase. All I wanted was to ask support for help, but the “user feedback” link goes to a list of help FAQs with now way to contact support. I am in one of the busiest periods of my life and the last thing I need is to struggle for days to get my alarm to work so that I don’t oversleep. I am giving this app a 1 star rating in the hopes that somebody on the Alarmy team will see this and get in touch with me to help me. Quite frankly, this is a terrible thing to have to resort to just to get an issue heard and resolved. Alarmy, you can do better!
